MIKEL OMEIBE

About Me

Curious about technology. Working toward a career in the cloud.

I’m Mikel Omeibe, a Computer Systems Technology student at Fanshawe College in London, Ontario. I enjoy understanding how things work, asking questions, and sticking with a problem until I find a way forward. Helping someone feel more confident with technology is one of the most rewarding parts of IT for me.

My goal is to become a cloud professional, with a focus on Microsoft Azure, infrastructure, and security. I’m especially interested in how networking, identity, and automation come together to build dependable cloud environments.

I’ve earned my Microsoft Azure Fundamentals certification and am working toward Azure Administrator certification. Through hands-on Azure and Linux projects, I’m building practical experience and learning from the troubleshooting along the way. My time in IT support at Compass Group also helped me develop patience, clear communication, and a practical approach to solving problems.

I’m looking forward to contributing to a team where I can keep growing, learn from experienced colleagues, and turn my curiosity into useful solutions.
